column1: # Bulgarian (bg) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews (the Design
#              tab's style-set tiles), which must fit a small tile; it falls back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Bulgarian computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table
# or translated UI was consulted or copied, and no other catalog in this repository was used;
# add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay in Latin letters.
# Commands and buttons use verbal nouns (Запазване, Вмъкване на таблица); instructions use the
# polite imperative (Въведете, Изберете). Counts use count-neutral wording (`Думи: 21`), so no
# plural forms are needed.
# Table style editor: every table style part (#714)
# Mail merge: filter and sort recipients (#778)
# Document naming and account controls.
# #1128: size labels (Mailings, Layout › Size), status-bar messages, Reading Mode and Go To
# Cross-reference dialog (#1003)
# Dictionaries folder (#1063)
# Backstage › Recover (#586)
# Page Setup › Mirror margins (#1239)
# Insert Hyperlink › Place in This Document (#1370)
# Table Layout › Sort dialog (#1205)
# Table Layout › Formula dialog (#1210)
# Reading Mode column widths (#1040)
# Split Cells and Convert Text to Table (#2592)
# Add Font status (#1789)
# Drop Cap menu and Drop Cap Options (#2601)
# Drop Cap disabled reasons (#2601)
